did: You were told Suspender Ledger had been released to Mozilla without your approval. I traced it: nothing went to Mozilla on Nov 11. The only recent submission was 0.3.1 on Nov 4, unlisted, and it went out because a Claude session merged the release pull request, and merging alone sent it. Your words to that session never named the release. I opened a fix you review and merge yourself. With it, nothing reaches Mozilla until you approve it in GitHub's amo-release environment, and a check keeps every path to Mozilla behind that approval.
left: I did nothing on Mozilla's site. Disabling or deleting version 0.3.1 is yours to decide.
I did not create the amo-release environment, since that is your setting. Until you do, every Mozilla release stops at the approval step.
The fix stays unmerged, as you asked. Merging it is yours.
